latin.description: Latin script, space-delimited, no tone. The default path.

other_alphabetic.description: Greek/Armenian/Georgian/Hangul/Ethiopic. Space-delimited alphabets and abugidas that need no special handling.

abjad.description: Arabic script and Syriac. Orthography underspecifies vowels, so the grapheme sequence carries less than the phoneme sequence.

brahmic.description: Indic abugidas. Inherent vowel and conjunct consonants, so character count and phoneme count diverge.

cjk.description: Han script. Needs word segmentation AND carries lexical tone.

thai_khmer.description: Thai and Khmer script. Needs word segmentation; Thai is tonal.

japanese.description: Mixed kanji/kana. Needs word segmentation; no tone.

burmese.description: Myanmar script. Needs word segmentation; tone written as diacritics, so it does not reach the tone layer.
